description: This source file defines a static helper class 'OptionHelper' that provides utility methods for creating command-line options and validating their values using the System.CommandLine library. It includes methods to create options with default values and validations, as well as specific validators for positive integers.

classes.name: OptionHelper
classes.description: A static class providing helper methods to create and validate command line options.

methods.name: CreateOption
methods.description: Creates a new command line option with specified alias, description, requirement, default value, and optional validator.

methods.name: Validator
methods.description: Validates the value of an option result using a provided predicate; returns an error message if invalid.

methods.name: OnlyStrictlyPositive
methods.description: Validator method that checks if an integer is strictly positive (> 0).

methods.name: OnlyPositiveOrZero
methods.description: Validator method that checks if an integer is zero or positive (>= 0).
